units.en: All countries, like in Vanilla, would start with Generic National Focus. But a special focus tree is created for each of the great powers of Vic2.
Generic Focus Tree
The generic focus tree has 5 main branches:
⟦0⟧ gives army experience and research bonuses to army research.
Army Effort
⟦0⟧ gives air experience, builds air bases, and research bonuses to air research.
Aviation Effort
⟦0⟧ gives navy experience, builds naval dockyards, and research bonuses to navy research.
Naval Effort
⟦0⟧ builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots.
Industrial Effort
⟦0⟧ gives the country choices on which political path they will take.
Political Effort
With the exception of ⟦0⟧, these branches are identical to ⟦1⟧
Vanilla generic focus trees
There are 2 additional branches dynamically generated by the Converter in the ⟦0⟧ section:
Generating reconquest wars
⟦0⟧ starts wars to take core states, gives some political power and ideas to help prepare for war
Reclaim Cores
⟦0⟧ adds claims on neighbors, starts wars to take claimed states and gives some war support and manpower
Territorial Disputes

They are added to all the countries that don't get their ⟦0⟧ (either because they are not a Great Power or player country, or because no targets could be acquired for their generation), provided there are potential target countries.
special focus tree
Victoria 2 allies, subjects and overlords are ineligible to become target countries for these branches. Also, ⟦0⟧ target countries are ineligible as targets for ⟦1⟧.

The number of sub-branches varies. A sub-branch will be generated for each target identified for ⟦0⟧ branch. If the number of target countries for ⟦1⟧ is greater than or equal to 4, then only 1 ⟦2⟧ branch will be generated. Otherwise, the combined number of these branches will amount to 5.
Depending on the selected ⟦0⟧ option, the Converter can add or remove branches compared to ⟦1⟧. The 2 new branches that can be created for converter ideologies are:

⟦0⟧ (aka ⟦1⟧) is designed to give the country war focuses for retaking core states not owned by it. After the ⟦2⟧ focus is selected, non-Fascist countries will get a modifier decreasing ⟦3⟧ and increasing the popularity of ⟦4⟧ ideology, until all the sub-branches have been completed, representing the Victoria 2 mechanism that drives countries with high revanchism towards ⟦5⟧, while making them more unstable through potential rebellions. As the progress down the branch continues, the ruling party popularity will increase, depending on the number of core provinces that would potentially be reclaimed.

⟦0⟧ branch war targets are determined based on Victoria 2 AI conquer province strategies (player country included). Province strategy values are summed up by owner countries to get the total value for potential targets, after which countries with value less than 10% of the top target value are discarded.
The ⟦0⟧ will be the state containing the Victoria 2 province most desired by the AI. If the country already had ⟦1⟧ on target country, those states will be used as War goal.
